_comment: Reference shape for the ucw-memory MCP server registration. install.sh generates the actual entry into ~/.claude/mcp.json with the absolute path to whichever Python has ucw_memory installed (typically $HOME/.claude/ucw/venv/bin/python on PEP 668 systems like Debian / Ubuntu / Zorin / Homebrew 3.11+; otherwise the system python3). Do not hand-copy this file into mcp.json — let install.sh build the entry so the command path is correct for your environment.
